# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-11-04

- First version: Hugging Face remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint `https://huggingface.co/mcp`, confirmed by a live initialize call (HTTP 200, serverInfo name huggingface.co/mcp).
- Works anonymously (rate limited); no account or key required.
